name: ═══════════════ WATER PUMP TELEGRAM INTEGRATION ═══════════════
info:
## Water Pump Telegram Integration

**Flow Number:** 411

### Purpose
Provides Telegram bot commands for water pump control.

### Commands
- `/pump_start` - Start main water pump
- `/pump_stop` - Stop main water pump
- `/pump_drain` - Drain water (10s pulse)
- `/pump_trench1_on` - Feed trench 1 ON
- `/pump_trench1_off` - Feed trench 1 OFF
- `/pump_trench2_on` - Feed trench 2 ON
- `/pump_trench2_off` - Feed trench 2 OFF
- `/pump_status` - Get status of all relays
- `/pump_help` - Show help for pump commands

### Features
- Individual relay control
- Comprehensive status display (4 relays)
- Interactive inline keyboard
- Command logging with request IDs
- Integration with shared telegram_bot_config

### Dependencies
- telegram_bot_config (shared)
- mqtt_broker_local
- water_pump_state (global context)

### Integration
Commands are routed from main Telegram interface (50-telegram-interface.json).
